model_interpretation.claim: Assigning four output particles to each thread should reuse each loaded source position and mass across four target-force accumulations, reducing repeated source loads. Four accumulators per target may raise register use and lower occupancy, so the factor-four mapping and 1024 logical outputs per 256-thread block are a measured candidate, not a predicted speedup.
